meta.name: cyberedge-observe-certificates
meta.description: Collect and inspect TLS leaf certificates for an explicitly authorized CyberEdge scope. Use only when an authorization reference already exists and active service discovery is permitted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 收集并检查授权范围内的 TLS 证书
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期检查 TLS 证书的有效性和安全性
copy.tagline_en: Collect and inspect TLS certificates for authorized scopes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly inspect TLS certificates for validity and security

howto.what: 安装此技能后，Claude 可以收集指定授权范围内的 TLS 叶子证书，执行扫描、搜索证书并生成包含主题、颁发者、SAN、有效期和 SHA-256 指纹的观察报告。
howto.when: 当用户有一个已存在的授权引用（authorization_ref）且允许主动服务发现时，请求检查特定 scope 的 TLS 证书即可触发。

say.text: 请检查 scope-123 的 TLS 证书。
say.note: Claude 会启动扫描并返回证书信息。

say.text: 报告 scope-abc 中所有证书的 SHA-256 指纹。
say.note: Claude 搜索证书并提取指纹。

say.text: 扫描并搜索 scope-xyz 的证书。
say.note: Claude 按流程执行扫描和搜索。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to collect and inspect TLS leaf certificates within an explicitly authorized CyberEdge scope. It performs scan, searches certificates, and generates observations including subject, issuer, SAN, validity, and SHA-256 fingerprint.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests certificate inspection for a specific scope that has an existing authorization reference and active service discovery is permitted.

say_en.text: Please check TLS certificates for scope-123.
say_en.note: Claude will start scan and return certificate info.

say_en.text: Report SHA-256 fingerprints of all certificates in scope-abc.
Scan and search certificates for scope-xyz.
say_en.note: Claude executes scan and search workflow.
